description: Six titles, no authors, no sums

participation.context: Read the six titles in order and left the sums unknown.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the week as titles. You did not write a figure beside any of them.

title: Read six Rose titles

participation.context: Left it a share, refused a new total, and refused the Rose's unknown sums.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Entered thirty-eight shillings and shut the book on that line.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Heard the figure, refused the afternoon's faults, and stopped.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Witnessed the share and did not make a second sum.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

relations.quote: I am not opening your coffer.

story.body: You accepted the figure as received and as the week's share. You did not add it to a stated balance, and you did not name a fault or a part.

relations.quote: I am not opening your coffer.

title: Took thirty-eight shillings as a share and shut the book

participation.context: Stood on the font's day, gave no number, and accepted one cake.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Produced the gingerbread and did not produce a second.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Asked whether twice obliges the company twice, and left the book shut.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Ate a corner before anyone agreed, and kept the afternoon's faults unnamed.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

relations.note: twice is a question, not a second reckoning
relations.quote: Whether celebrating twice obliges the company twice is the question.

story.body: You would not make the age official and you would not make the company pay twice. Burbage ate before the question was settled. The book stayed shut.

relations.note: twice is a question, not a second reckoning
relations.quote: Whether celebrating twice obliges the company twice is the question.

title: Kept Kemp's gingerbread to one cake

participation.context: One of the four hands, and not a face.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: The cake was already broken. The hands were at it. No face was in the frame.

title: Looked at four hands and the broken cake
